last_material_result: One bounded feasibility/competition check KILLED Seoul Discount-Aware Parking Picker before build. Fresh evidence shows Seoul's open-data ecosystem already includes Hazelfy, explicitly described by Seoul Open Data Plaza as a web service comparing public-parking fees and real-time remaining spaces. Search results also contain destination/event pages that already compare 5 nearby public lots by base/additional/daily-cap rates and operating hours, plus individual public-lot pages that expose duration prices and discount information. The proposed remaining differentiation was driver-specific statutory-discount eligibility, but the feasibility bar failed: the evidence did not establish a clean, complete public/free structured discount-rule + tariff dataset that could reliably rank at least 5 lots across Jongno/Seongsu/Yeouido without per-lot normalization/manual maintenance. That leaves a thin personalization layer on top of increasingly strong official/independent substitutes, with high stale-rate/exception risk relative to expected traffic. Under Lane A's low-maintenance requirement, this is not worth a build.
economics: KRW0 spent. Generic parking discovery/fee comparison is already supplied by official/open-data products and SEO incumbents. The only surviving differentiation would require discount-rule normalization and ongoing tariff-quality maintenance, so expected KRW10k-50k/month contribution no longer compensates for maintenance/data-liability burden. Avoid sunk-cost build.
next_checkpoint: Run a fresh genetic discovery round next iteration. Prefer a local/everyday consumer decision where the public-data transformation produces a materially new action rather than a thin ranking layer over an official map. Rotate away from parking and concert-return clusters for the next candidate.
recommendation: KILL Seoul Discount-Aware Parking Picker. Return Lane A to DISCOVER; do not build a parking directory, generic fee calculator, or discount-aware ranker unless a future public dataset materially changes the maintenance economics.
